name: security-requirements
description: Derives tailored security requirements for a service from NIST CSF 2.0, SP 800-53, OWASP ASVS, and cloud provider guidance.

metadata.description: Prescriptive security requirements, as opposed to vulnerability discovery.

plugins.name: security-requirements
plugins.description: Derives what a service must satisfy, before or independently of any code existing. Bundles the NIST 800-53 Rev 5 catalog, CSF 2.0, and ASVS 5.0 so cited control identifiers are checked rather than recalled.
